items.title: UK Trade Marks Journal dataset: weekly accepted applications with classes, applicant and opposition deadline (+ stats page, Apify actor)
items.why: Exchange 2026-W39 winner. Watch services charge £180–320/mark/yr to scan this journal; Apify UK trademark actor $0.05/record. Weekly OGL XML (~15 MB zip) from ipo.gov.uk/t-tmj.htm; rolling 52 issues; own Saturday wave. Schema undocumented and ipo.gov.uk unreachable from the routine container — write from a sample, hand off verification. Organisation-level fields only.
items.proof: queries + paywall hits + get_changes calls on the dataset in 30 days (Analytics Engine); Apify paid runs once actors unblock

items.title: Gambling Commission operator register dataset (operators, premises, regulatory actions)
items.why: Exchange 2026-W39 runner-up. 2,642 operators, daily CSV/ZIP, no login; Apify actors price it from $8/1k rows; KYB/payments/affiliate-compliance buyers. Confirm the OGL statement on the data.gov.uk "Operator licence register" record before publishing (mark blocked if it cannot be read).
items.proof: queries + paywall hits on the dataset in 30 days (Analytics Engine)

items.why: Turns the journal dataset into the product the watch services sell (monthly similar-mark reports); cite-bait pages target "trade mark applications this week class N" searches. Needs uk-trademark-journal live.
items.proof: ≥ 20 get_changes calls/week filtered on the dataset; stats pages indexed
